questions.question: If x + (1)/(x) = 2sqrt 5, then what is the value of (( x⁴ + frac{1)/(x²) )}{x² + 1} ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + (1)/(x) = 2√ 5

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

x + (1)/(x) = 2√ 5

Cube both sides, we get

⇒ (x + 1/x)³ = (2√5)³ 

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 × x × 1/x (2√5) = 40√5

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 6√5 = 40√5

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = (40√5 – 6√5)

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 34√5

Now,

(( x⁴ + frac{1)/(x²) )}{x² + 1}

Dividing the equation by x, we get

⇒ (x³ + 1/x³)/(x + 1/x)

⇒ (34√5/2√5)

⇒ 17

**∴ The required value is 17**

questions.question: If ( sin² θ)/(tan² θ - sin² θ) = 5, θ is an acute angle, then the value of (24 sin² theta - 15 sec² theta)/(6 cosec² theta - 7 cot² theta) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

( sin² θ)/(tan² θ - sin² θ) = 5

**Formula used:**

AB² – BC² = AC²

sinθ = p/h

cosecθ = h/p

secθ = h/b

cotθ = b/p

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83579d774639d102854a452174c19c7696b8097f943e20d36d08d856b5ef15aa.png] 

( sin² θ)/(tan² θ - sin² θ) = 5

⇒ sin²θ/(sin²θ/cos²θ – sin²θ) = 5

⇒ sin²θ/(sin²θ/1/sec²θ – sin²θ) = 5

⇒ sin²θ/sin²θ .(sec²θ – sin²θ) = 5

⇒ sin²θ/sin²θ(sec²θ – 1) = 5

⇒ sec²θ – 1 = 1/5

⇒ sec²θ = (1/5 + 1)

⇒ sec²θ = 6/5

⇒ secθ = √6/√5

Now,

sinθ = 1/√6

secθ = √6/√5

cosecθ = √6/1

cotθ = √5/1

The value of (24 sin² θ - 15 sec² θ)/(6 cosec² θ - 7 cot² θ) 

⇒ [24 × (1√6)² – (15 × √6/√5)²]/[6 × √6/1)² – (7 × √5/1)²]

⇒ (24 × 1/6 – 15 × 6/5)/(6 × 6 – 7 × 5)

⇒ (4 – 18)/(36 – 35)

⇒ (-14/1)

⇒ -14

**∴ The required value is -14**

questions.question: If x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴ = 21 and x² + xy + y² = 3, then what is the value of (-xy)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = 21 and x2 + xy + y2 = 3

**Formula used:**

x4 + x2y2 + y⁴ = (x² – xy + y²) (x2 + xy + y²)

**Calculation:**

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = 21 

And, x2 + xy + y2 = 3 ......(1)

Now,

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = (x2 – xy + y2) (x2 + xy + y2)

⇒ 21 = (x2 – xy + y2) × 3

⇒ (x2 – xy + y2) = 7 ......(2)

Subtracting equation (2) from (1) we get,

(x2 – xy + y² = 7) – (x2 + xy + y2 = 3)

⇒ 2xy = (-4)

⇒ xy = (-4/2)

⇒ xy = -2

Now,

The value of -xy = 2

**∴ The required value is 2**

questions.question: In ΔABC, D is a point on BC such that ∠BAD = (1)/(2)∠ADC and ∠BAC = 77° and ∠C = 45°. What is the measure of ∠ADB ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠BAD = 1/2∠ADC

∠BAC = 77° 

∠C = 45° 

**Concept used:**

**The exterior angle theorem: **It states that if a triangle's side is extended, then the resultant exterior angle would be equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles of the triangle.

**Angle sum property: **Sum of all the three angles of a triangle is 180°.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b94537a551d3aa8b9cfa4f1630db2f26b7baf21eb134cae99b24bd455b6f0af.png] 

In ΔABC,

∠BAC + ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 180° [Angle sum property]

⇒ 77° + ∠ABC + 45° = 180° 

⇒ 122° + ∠ABC = 180° 

⇒ ∠ABC = (180° – 122°)

⇒ ∠ABC = 58° 

In ΔBAD,

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠BAD = ∠ADC [Exterior angle theorem] 

⇒ 58° + ∠BAD = 2∠ADC

⇒ ∠BAD = 58° 

In ΔBAD,

⇒ ∠ABD + ∠BAD + ∠ADB = 180° [Angle sum property]

⇒ 58° + 58° + ∠ADB = 180° 

⇒ 116° + ∠ADB = 180° 

⇒ ∠ADB = (180° – 116°)

⇒ ∠ADB = 64° 

**∴ The required value of ∠ADB is 64°**

questions.question: if x is subtracted from each of 24, 40, 33 and 57, the numbers, so obtained are in proportion. The ratio of (5x + 12) to (4x + 15) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x is subtracted from each of 24, 40, 33 and 57

**Concept used:**

Componendo and Dividendo

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ (24 – x)/(40 – x) = (33 – x)/(57 – x)

Using Componendo and Dividendo 

(24 – x + 40 – x)/(24 – x – 40 + x) = (33 – x + 57 – x)/(33 – x – 57 + x)

⇒ (64 – 2x)/(-16) = (90 – 2x)/(-24)

⇒ 3(64 – 2x) = 2(90 – 2x)

⇒ 192 – 6x = 180 – 4x

⇒ (180 – 192) = (4x – 6x)

⇒ -12 = -2x

⇒ x = 6

Now,

The ratio of (5x + 12) to (4x + 15) = (5 × 6 + 12) : (4 × 6 + 15)

⇒ (42 : 39)

⇒ 14 : 13

**∴ The required ratio is 14 : 13**

questions.question: If the six-digit number 5z3x4y is divisible by 7, 11 and 13, then what is the value of (x + y - z) ?
questions.solution:
Given:

The six digit number = 5z3x4y

Concept used:

Divisibility rule of 7 - The difference between twice the unit digit of the given number and the remaining part of the given number should be a multiple of 7 or it should be equal to 0.

Divisibility rule of 11 - If the difference between the sum of the digits at the odd and even places equals 0 or divisible by 11, then the number is divisible by 11.

Divisibility rule of 13 - A number is divisible by 13 when the ones place digit of a number is multiplied by 4 and the product is added to the rest of the number either gives 0 or a multiple of 13.

7 × 11 × 13 = 1001, when any three digit number multiplied by 1001 then it repeats itself and always completely divisible by 7, 11 and 13.

Calculation:

Let 3 digit number be pqr

⇒ pqr × 1001 = 5z3x4y

⇒ pqrpqr = 5z3x4y

compare both sides

⇒ p = 5, q = 4 and r = 3

Hence that number is 543543

⇒ 5z3x4y = 543543

By comparing both number, x = 5, y = 3 and z = 4

Now,

The value of (x + y – z) = (5 + 3 – 4)

⇒ (8 – 4)

⇒ 4

**∴ The required value is 4**

questions.question: A car can cover a distance of 144 km in 1.8 hours. In what time (in hours) will it cover double the distance when its speed is increased by 20%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance of a car = 144 km

Time = 1.8 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ Speed = (144/1.8)

⇒ Speed = 80 km/hr

Now,

Speed is increased by 20% = (80 × 20/100) = 16

New speed = (80 + 16) = 96 km/hr

Now,

Time to cover the double the distance = (2 × 144)/96

⇒ (6/2)

⇒ 3 hour

**∴ The required time is 3 hour**

questions.question: The area of a circular path enclosed by two concentric circles is 3080 m². If the difference between the radius of the outer edge and that of inner edge of the circular path is 10 m, what is the sum (in m) of the two radii? (take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of a circular path enclosed by two concentric circles = 3080 m2.

The difference between the radius of the outer edge and that of inner edge of the circular path = 10 m

**Formula used:**

Area of circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05a02845c553240ba2eaa9e999dfb022c0dbd315b4fee45609c6d1f8a09efd70.png] 

The outer edge of the radius of the circle be R

The inner edge of the radius of the circle be r

According to the question

⇒ (R – r) = 10 m .....(1)

Now,

Area of circle = π(R² – r²) = 3080

⇒ 22 / 7(R + r)(R – r) = 3080

⇒ (R + r)(R – r) = 980

Now, putting the value of (R – r), we get

⇒ (R + r)(10) = 980

⇒ (R + r) = (980 / 10) m

⇒ (R + r) = 98 m

**∴ The required sum of the two radii is 98 m**
